title: Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms
abstract: arXiv:2610.17762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. translated_title: 面向大规模太阳能电站的自主三维视觉-热成像检测系统
translated_abstract: 大规模光伏（PV）电站检测目前以航空巡检为主，这种方法虽然能有效识别组件级别的热斑电池，但对位于光伏阵列下方的关键部件（包括连接器、电缆、紧固件和结构元件）的可见性十分有限。这些设备难以在大规模范围内进行一致的检测，其缺陷通常在空间上尺寸很小、部分被遮挡，且难以从孤立的图像中定位。我们提出了一种用于光伏板下资产检测的自动化三维视觉-热成像检测系统。该方法将激光雷达-惯性同步定位与建图（SLAM）与经过几何标定的RGB和热成像图像以及基于机器学习的目标检测和分割相结合。检测到的资产与重建的三维环境相关联，使来自多个视角的视觉和热观测能够在空间上融合并实现定位。我们展示了……
tldr: 该论文提出了名为Tricorder的自动化三维视觉-热成像检测系统，结合激光雷达-惯性SLAM、几何标定的RGB与热成像图像以及机器学习检测分割技术，将检测到的光伏阵列下方关键部件（如连接器、电缆、紧固件）与重建的三维环境关联，实现多视角视觉与热观测的空间融合与定位，弥补了传统航空巡检对阵列下方组件检测能力不足的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Tricorder, an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system that combines LiDAR-inertial SLAM with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine learning-based detection to spatially fuse multi-viewpoint observations and localize under-panel PV assets such as connectors and cabling, addressing the limitations of aerial surveys.
